title: Pre-registration of stage E15: sensitivity of the CEC2014 replication to the composition-rule amendment
status: exploratory sensitivity analysis, registered before it is run but after the confirmatory CEC2014 analysis (E13) and after the amendment it examines
why: The composition decision for the repaired method (E8/E11, CEC2022) was made with a rule amended after its first output had been seen. The rule as coded before E8 ran (2026-09-14T07:48Z) returned KEEP for COBL, Levy, archive and SHADE memory and DROP only for the p annealing (output 2026-09-14T09:01:22Z); the amended rule (2026-09-14T09:02Z) also drops COBL and Levy, and that stripped configuration was frozen and evaluated in E13. E15 asks whether the pre-registered E13 conclusion (the repair replicates against SEHHO-COBL) depends on the amendment.
configuration_description: gate-free (phase_mode=always_pbest), LPSR from N_init=6D (budget-based schedule), COBL initialisation kept, Levy perturbation kept (levy_mode default 'phase', which under always_pbest fires on every individual's Levy draw), external archive and SHADE memory kept, p annealing removed (p fixed)

design.suite: CEC2014 Part A, official C sources, functions 1-30
design.comparators: SEHHO-COBL and GF-Method (R-SHADE) runs of E13 in the identical cells (not re-run)

sensitivity_primary.comparison: GF:OriginalRule against SEHHO-COBL at the competition budget, D=30 and D=50
sensitivity_primary.statistic: Cliff's delta per function over the 30 runs, averaged over the 30 functions; 95% percentile bootstrap, 20,000 resamples, seed 20260915; negative favours GF:OriginalRule
sensitivity_primary.test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on the 30 per-function deltas, Holm-corrected across the two blocks
sensitivity_primary.criterion: Same as the E13 success criterion: replicates if the 95% interval excludes zero in GF:OriginalRule's favour in BOTH blocks; one block = partial; neither = does not replicate.

secondary.comparison: GF:OriginalRule against GF-Method (R-SHADE) in all four blocks (D=30/50 x competition/tight)
secondary.statistic: as above, negative favours GF:OriginalRule; Holm across the four blocks
secondary.classification: negligible if the whole 95% interval lies inside |delta|<0.147; 'R-SHADE better' if the interval lies above 0; 'original-rule configuration better' if it lies below 0; otherwise inconclusive

descriptive: GF:OriginalRule against SEHHO-COBL at the tight budget; R-SHADE against SEHHO-COBL reproduced from E13 for side-by-side reporting
commitments: E15 is reported in the paper whatever it shows, labelled exploratory.
Nothing in E15 may change the frozen configuration, the E13 primary result, or any design decision.
No comparison beyond those listed here will be reported from E15 except as explicitly labelled additional exploration.
